title: The Value Sensitivity Gap: How Clinical Large Language Models Respond to Patient Preference Statements in Shared Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: The study measures 'Default Value Orientation' (DVO) by quantifying the baseline aggressiveness and risk levels of model recommendations for clinical vignettes in the absence of patient preferences. It further evaluates 'Value Sensitivity' by measuring how much these recommendations shift when specific patient value statements (e.g., regarding risk tolerance, quality of life vs. longevity, cost sensitivity) are added to the prompt.
